adoption.notes: The README states the SDK mirrors this contract family and produces this document.

hunks.summary: The signature field row: enforced for the community install path, ed25519 signatures and the bundled sentinel. A new requirement and refusal. Restored out of v1; skills-package/v2 carries signature enforcement.
escalate_to loses cloud as a valid value. A tightened rule. Restored out of v1; skills-package/v2 carries it.
New trigger fields reasoning_policy and requires_approval. Restored out of v1; skills-package/v2 carries them.

Four new load-time refusals and the Tier B post-action policy with its reasoning_status values. Restored out of v1; skills-package/v2 carries them through its reference to v1 as it stood at its freeze, and skills-package/v3 states them.

{history.*} placeholders evaluated with AST-safe parsing, their methods and cap of 16, unresolved placeholders as null, the prompt assembly order and the context enricher note. New behaviour and a new refusal. Restored out of v1; skills-package/v2 carries them through its pinned reference, and skills-package/v3 states them.
The hook sandbox becomes an OS-level seccomp and Landlock sandbox with fallback. Restored out of v1; the rule is obsolete in skills-package/v2, which executes no community hooks.

The signature field status section becomes signature verification notes: manifest and artifact verification, the bundled sentinel and its refusal for community skills, and signing/v1. New requirements. Restored out of v1; skills-package/v2 carries them.
Part of the signature verification change: the G-07 open-gap sentence is removed. Restored out of v1 with the section above.

The header says skills-package/v2 supersedes this version, that this is the text frozen at ori-runtime v0.9.0-beta.1 and not updated for later runtime behaviour, that 2.4.0 and later do not execute community hooks, and points at v2's migration section. A pointer to this contract's successor; it changes no v1 obligation.

notes: Runtime releases before 2.4.0 accept this version; 2.4.0 and later accept skills-package/v2.
